userStories.title: Fix auto_scale not triggering for large batches with restored checkpoint
acceptanceCriteria: When checkpoint restores retry budget with attempts, scaling still occurs for current batch size
Batch of 175 videos results in max_attempts >= 350 (175 * 2.0 attempts_per_video)
Log message shows scaled max_attempts when batch_size > original max_attempts
Add test: restore budget with 50 attempts used, new batch of 200, verify scaling to 400
ensure_scaled() considers remaining budget headroom, not just current max_attempts
userStories.notes:
Tier 1 Bug Fix (Critical): src/caption/retry_budget.py + src/stages/caption_stage.py

User log shows: 175 videos, 100 max_attempts, 99 successes then budget_exhausted at video 101.

With auto_scale=true (default), a batch of 175 should scale to 175*2.0=350 attempts.

Likely cause: Either auto_scale config is false, or ensure_scaled() isn't called after checkpoint restore, or the scaling logic has a bug when budget already has attempts used.

Key methods:
- ensure_scaled() in retry_budget.py
- Lines 693-770 in caption_stage.py where scaling occurs

userStories.title: Add diagnostic logging when budget exhausts before batch completes
acceptanceCriteria: When budget_exhausted() returns True, log includes: auto_scale setting, batch_size, config max_attempts, scaled max_attempts
Log shows why scaling didn't help (e.g., 'auto_scale=false' or 'scaling not triggered')
Include top 3 error categories from error_counts in exhaustion log
Add test that verifies diagnostic info is logged when budget exhausts
Diagnostic log uses INFO level and includes [US-42-005] marker
userStories.notes:
Tier 2 Enhancement: src/caption/retry_budget.py budget_exhausted() method (lines 297-342)

The current EXHAUSTED log only shows attempts/max_attempts. Adding diagnostic context helps users understand why budget was insufficient.

Log format: 'CaptionRetryBudget: EXHAUSTED (attempts: 100/100) [US-42-005] auto_scale=false, batch_size=175, original_max=100, top_errors=[RATE_LIMIT:45, TIMEOUT:30]'

userStories.title: Add config validation warning for auto_scale=false with large batches
acceptanceCriteria: _validate_budget_for_batch() warns when auto_scale=false AND batch_size > max_attempts
Warning message recommends enabling auto_scale or increasing max_attempts
Warning includes specific formula: 'batch_size * attempts_per_video = required_budget'
Add test: batch_size=200, max_attempts=100, auto_scale=false should log warning
Warning uses logger.warning() for visibility
userStories.notes:
Tier 2 Enhancement: src/stages/caption_stage.py _validate_budget_for_batch() method (lines 1128-1170)

Existing validation only warns if max_attempts < batch_size. Enhance to warn when auto_scale is disabled and budget may be insufficient.

This proactively alerts users before they hit exhaustion.

userStories.title: Verify ensure_scaled resets budget counters when scaling up from restored state
acceptanceCriteria: Document behavior: ensure_scaled() does NOT reset attempts counter when scaling
If reset_on_scale=true, ensure_scaled() resets attempts to 0 when scaling up
Add test: budget has 80 attempts used, scale up, verify attempts counter behavior based on reset_on_scale
Log when scaling resets counters: '[US-42-007] Budget scaled and reset: attempts 80->0'
Add comment in ensure_scaled() explaining the reset_on_scale behavior
userStories.notes:
Tier 2 Investigation: src/caption/retry_budget.py ensure_scaled() method

US-41-009 added reset_on_scale config but need to verify it works correctly when restoring from checkpoint and then scaling.

Scenario: Checkpoint has 80/100 attempts used. New batch needs 200 attempts. Scale to 200, but should attempts stay at 80 or reset to 0?

Default (reset_on_scale=false): Keep attempts, so only 120 attempts remaining.
With reset_on_scale=true: Reset attempts to 0, so 200 attempts available.

userStories.title: Add graceful degradation when budget insufficient for batch
acceptanceCriteria: When budget is insufficient (remaining < batch_size), offer option to continue with warning

Tier 3 Enhancement: src/stages/caption_stage.py

userStories.title: Add CLI flag to reset retry budget on resume
acceptanceCriteria: Add --reset-budget flag to main.py CLI
When flag is set, retry budget counters are reset to 0 even when restoring from checkpoint
Flag is documented in --help output
Add test: run with --resume --reset-budget, verify budget counters are 0
Log when flag triggers reset: 'Retry budget reset by --reset-budget flag'
userStories.notes:
Tier 3 Enhancement: main.py, src/cli/args.py

Gives users manual control when they know rate limiting has subsided and want to retry with fresh budget.

Alternative to increasing max_attempts - just reset the counters.
